description: Media Resource Unification (epic #491, frontend half) - unify the media HTTP surface and its client mirror. Server: one /api/media/* adapter (a generic registry-dispatched source resolver GET /api/media/sources/:sourceId plus title/counts/moods/writes endpoints) composing the EXISTING home/watchlist/media module barrels. Wire: extend @ent-mcp/shared/media with the MEDIA_SOURCE_IDS as-const tuple, the relocated cursor codec, per-source param schemas, and the canonical Page shape. Client: one shared/media/ layer (one list-hook core, one query-key root, one MediaApiError, shared card/skeleton primitives); home and watchlist become thin shells. Plus adjacent tracks: watchlist route loaders (#513), Paraglide ICU variants (#511/#512), all-items virtual scroll (#519), correctness nits (#514/#515/#516). SOURCE OF TRUTH: docs/2026-05-30-media-resource-unification-design.md - read it before each story; the design wins on any conflict. Section refs (A1, B2, ...) and invariant/risk tags (V.RG1, V.A1, V.CU1, RISK-205, ...) point into that design. Extends the shipped docs/2026-05-26-media-pipeline-consolidation-design.md (commit dacd3825) which unified the internal read path; this work unifies the HTTP surface and its client mirror. NO server module re-org: no composition logic moves between home/watchlist/media (invariant V.A1); media never imports concrete sources (invariant V.RG1) - the source registry lives in the api/ adapter, composed from consumer barrels. The URL reflects the resource; the owning module reflects the logic; the adapter bridges them. Additive-first/subtractive-last: Part A (US-001..US-005) adds /api/media/* WITHOUT removing the old endpoints; Part B (US-006..US-012) migrates the client; the old surface is deleted ONLY in the cutover (US-013) - this is sequencing, NOT a compat shim (no translation layer, no dual maintenance). Use Vite+ only: `vp check`, `vp test`, `vp install` (never pnpm/npm/yarn/vitest/oxlint directly); `vp dlx` for one-off binaries. CHANGESET RULE: @ent-mcp/shared is internal-only and is NEVER listed in a changeset - its changes ride the consumer bump. User-facing minor bumps land at US-010 (@ent-mcp/client), US-012 (@ent-mcp/client), and US-013 (@ent-mcp/client + @ent-mcp/server); every other story uses an empty-frontmatter changeset (---\n---). Parity is the success bar: capture fixtures from the LIVE old endpoints BEFORE US-003/US-004/US-005 and assert the new surface matches item ids/order/cursor - no user-visible behavior change except what the adjacent tracks (#511-#519) explicitly specify. Every Part B story edits apps/client/ React: invoke the relevant frontend skill before editing (frontend-feature-architecture, vercel-react-best-practices, vercel-composition-patterns, paraglide-js, vercel-react-view-transitions). Compact context at each phase boundary.

userStories.title: Generic source resolver endpoint
userStories.description: As a client developer, I want one paginated read endpoint dispatched by source id so that every media list reads through a single path (A3).
acceptanceCriteria: api/procedures/media.ts defines a REGISTRY: Record<MediaSourceId, MediaSourceRegistration> composed as { ...homeMediaSources, ...watchlistMediaSources }, and mounts GET /api/media/sources/:sourceId ADDITIVELY (old endpoints stay).

The resolver is dumb dispatch (invariant V.MC1/V.PG1 - no enrich / sort / cursor logic in the resolver): look up the registration (unknown -> 404 media.source_unknown), apply reg.rateLimit, build the source context, run reg.eligibility if present (ineligible -> 404 media.source_ineligible), parse reg.paramSchema (invalid -> 400 http.invalid_input), decode the cursor, map null per reg.cursorOnNull (home '400' -> 400 media.cursor_invalid; watchlist 'firstPage' -> null), enforce requiresInitialCursor (missing -> 400 media.cursor_required), then build -> listRows(source, cfg, ctx, enrichRows) -> return the Page.

Two-level cursor decode holds: the resolver decodes only the opaque OUTER Cursor; the source still parses its seed/keyset payload out of Cursor.k (decodeSeedToken in similar-paged, keyset decode in watchlist items) - inner-token parsing stays source-side, unchanged.
Bounded sources (tonight / recently) return Page with cursor: null; today's WatchlistSectionResponse ({ items, partial }) gains the cursor field (pre-stable additive).
requireSession is applied .use('*') on the /api/media router; sessionUserId(c) is read per handler.

Resolver unit tests cover: unknown sourceId -> 404, ineligible -> 404, bad params -> 400, cursor-null mapping per cursorOnNull (home 400 / watchlist first-page), requiresInitialCursor -> 400, and rate-limit applied per registration.

Read parity: for every list source, the resolver returns the same item ids / order / cursor as the corresponding old endpoint (/home/row, /watchlist/items, /watchlist/sections/*, /watchlist/moods/:moodId/items). Fixtures are captured from the LIVE old endpoints BEFORE this phase and asserted against the resolver (RISK-202).
